words.word: upon me and that which i was afraid

occurrences.text: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the Lord was wroth against you to destroy you. But the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also.
Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
words: upon me and that which I was afraid

occurrences.text: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
